artworks.title: Portrait of a Youth
artworks.medium: Chalk with stumping and white chalk heightening on tan multifiber wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Catherine Lees Causey
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person's upper body, with a focus on the head and shoulders. The person is in a three-quarter view, looking to their right side. The facial features include eyes, a nose, and lips. The hair is shoulder-length with gentle waves around the face. The drawing does not include clothing, jewelry, or objects. The background is plain with a brownish-tan paper texture. A signature and date "Genito, 1923" are in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Niagara Falls
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall captured from a low angle looking upwards. The waterfall cascades from the left side, creating a curtain of water that fills much of the view. Large, billowing clouds are visible in the sky above. The water has a smooth yet forceful texture, suggesting its relentless motion. The color palette includes sepia tones, adding a classic, vintage feel. Dark silhouettes of rocks and vegetation are visible. Lush foliage provides a sense of scale and depth in the image.

artworks.title: Frozen Falls
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a frozen waterfall scene with icicles hanging over the edge. Buildings and trees far in the distance are barely visible, covered in snow. The water below is partly hidden by mist, with no visible brushstrokes. The color palette is primarily brown and white, creating a cold, wintry atmosphere. Snow-covered branches and rocks near the viewer lead towards the misty waterfall.

artworks.title: Construction of Washington Aqueduct
artworks.description: The image depicts a waterfront scene with a large wooden structure, a man in a hat standing by a boat with sails up, and multiple masts in the background. The town's rooftops, small details, and a horizon with clear visibility are also shown. The photo has a monochromatic color palette and a calm water surface. Blurry figures are seen sitting nearby, and stones are arranged along the shore.

artworks.title: Notizie del mondo [News of the World]
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing closely together. Two lean towards the third person who is looking at a paper. All of them wear traditional garments and large headpieces. The background is dark. One of the individuals is holding the paper.

artworks.title: Un mattino di settembre [A September Morning]
artworks.medium: etching with roulette on wove paper
artworks.description: The scene depicts a view from within a forest. The viewpoint is below the trees, allowing a look through the trunks and foliage of tall trees dominating the scene. The horizon is obscured by the trees, with their trunks extending upward and branches spreading outwards. The etched lines provide detailed rendering of the trees, leaves, and ground texture, creating a richly textured black-and-white image. The color palette is grayscale, using shading variations for depth and detail. Tree trunks, shadowed grassy paths, and distant converging trees are visible, adding depth and mystery to the woodland setting.

artworks.title: Study of Lions
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple studies of lions in different positions. The drawing features sketches of lions in various poses and angles. There is a reclining lion with detailed mane and anatomy, surrounded by quick sketches of a lion's face highlighting mane texture and gaze intensity. A lion in a prowling position is shown nearby, emphasizing its sleek form and strength. Additionally, a smaller sketch depicts two animals interacting on a perch. Intricate line work, shading, and texturing capture the lions' character and majesty in different stances and expressions.

artworks.title: Reading in a Garden (Lettura in giardino)
artworks.medium: color monotype with scraping, additional oil color, graphite and colored pencils on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated from just below the waist up. The individual's facial features are blurry, and they wear a hat. They wear a loose-fitting garment, with visible sleeves. The left hand rests on the surface, and the right hand holds a piece of paper. The background is filled with greenery and a textured sky in blue and white.

artworks.title: Alessandro Manzoni
artworks.description: The image showcases a profile portrait of a man with his head and a portion of his neck depicted. He is facing the left side of the image, presented on a round medallion-like plaque. The man has a prominent nose, a defined jawline, and curly hair with sideburns. His facial features are sharply defined in a neoclassical style. The medallion is inscribed with the words "ALESSANDRO MANZONI." The background surrounding the medallion is plain and light beige, emphasizing the detailed engraving within. No additional objects or jewelry are visible in the image.

artworks.title: Market in Tangiers [Mercato di Tangeri]
artworks.medium: etching on chine appliqué [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of large jugs arranged in front of a textured wall. The drawing portrays an outdoor scene where several large jugs are positioned prominently in the foreground. The background features a textured wall. Intricate line work conveys depth and shadow, while light and shade suggest natural illumination, highlighting the details of the jugs and the textures surrounding them.

artworks.title: Abbrutimento  (Ricordo di Constantinopoli) [Brutalization (Souvenir of Constantinople)]
artworks.description: The image shows a person leaning against a stone structure with their left arm extended horizontally to support themselves. Their head is slightly bowed forward, and the shadow partially obscures their facial features. The person's hair appears tousled and dark. They are wearing a loose-fitting garment that wraps around their torso and drapes down to their lower legs, along with sandals on their feet. The extended left arm is holding a rosary, with the beads hanging down. The background consists of a textured stone wall, indicating an architectural setting, with intricate patterns and shadows giving depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Nel Villaggio [In the Village]
artworks.artist: Domenico Casella, after Serafin de Avendano
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene with residential structures, a tree, and a pathway. The artwork features detailed etching with fine cross-hatching for texture, using a monochromatic color palette of black and gray tones for a quiet atmosphere.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: The image shows a standing male leaning against a rectangular slab inscribed with text. He has a classical facial features, dark curly hair, and is nude with a cloth around his waist. He stands on a textured surface with a plain background. The scene is depicted in fine linework.

artworks.title: La Victoire (Victory)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a nude male figure standing with a relaxed posture. He is leaning against a surface with his right arm braced on a platform. The man's head is tilted slightly upward and to the side, featuring curly hair. His facial features appear strong with classical sculpted features. He is holding a small statuette or sculpture in his left hand. The background consists of textured and crosshatched shading.

artworks.title: Ada
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a head and shoulders view. The person is turned slightly to the side with a contemplative gaze. Their facial features are delicately rendered, with a strong jawline and shadowed eyes. They have relatively short hair, blending into a wide-brimmed hat. The clothing is suggested with sketchy lines, possibly indicating a collared garment. The style is sketch-like with cross-hatching for depth and shading. The background is abstract with sketch-like textures, focusing on the figure without specific details.

artworks.title: Et ecce sedes posita erat in coelo... (God the Son in Majesty on the Throne Surrounded by the Four Creatures and Worshipped by the Twenty-four Elders)
artworks.description: The image shows a central figure seated on a throne with a regal posture, surrounded by various animals and human-like figures in a grand setting.

artworks.title: A Turkish Palace (Probably for Mozart's "Abduction from the Seraglio")
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor
artworks.description: The image shows a symmetrical view of an ornate architectural scene. The perspective is straight on, emphasizing a grand staircase, structure, and trees. The art style is detailed with precise lines and fine shading to depict depth and texture. The color palette includes muted tones of beige, gray, soft blues, and subtle hints of color, creating a serene and classical atmosphere. Pillars, iron gates, and a staircase lead to a prominent building in the distance. The sky is lightly rendered to highlight the foreground details and trees.

artworks.title: Woman Reading [Donna che legge]
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting the upper half of a seated person holding and reading a piece of paper or a book. The facial features are faintly detailed, with textured hair. The clothing is simple, with broad strokes indicating a long-sleeved garment. The background is minimal, with cross-hatched shading creating a textured, abstract appearance. The etching conveys a mix of shadows through its varied line work.

artworks.title: The Archer [L'Arciere]
artworks.medium: Chiaroscuro woodcut from two blocks, printed in red-brown and ocher
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular male figure in a dynamic pose on rocky terrain. He is balancing on one leg with the other behind, with one arm extended and the other holding a staff upright on his shoulder. He has defined facial features, short wavy hair, and appears nude. The background features swirling lines and patterns.

artworks.title: What Is It? (Che c'è?)
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl standing among sheep on a rocky terrain. The girl is positioned to the right and looking to the left. The land slopes gently to the left, with sheep leading in that direction. The artwork has detailed linework capturing textures in the girl's clothing, sheep wool, and the rocky ground. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of gray. The sky has subtle shading and a few birds are present.

artworks.title: With Pride Upon Her Brow
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on one newsprint page of a 20-page book-fold edition of Harper's Weekly from Saturday, November 9, 1878
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a rustic building with people outside. The building is weathered and wooden, with a porch where figures are seated. In the foreground, a woman in period attire walks with two children playing nearby. The people on the porch appear relaxed while the woman walks by with a confident posture. The building's facade shows signs of wear and age, with a rough texture and small windows with shutters. The drawing is in a monochromatic palette, capturing a moment of everyday life from a historical time period.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Scientist
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund

artworks.title: Portrait of Three Men
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: Three men are shown in the image. Two men are seated in the foreground, one on the left holding a guitar and the other on the right holding a small statue and a flag resembling the American flag. Both have mustaches. The man on the left has curly hair and wears a bowler hat, while the man on the right also wears a hat, with neatly styled hair and a patterned robe or overcoat. The third man in the background is obscured but holds a similar flag, has facial hair, and is smoking a pipe. The setting appears to be an indoor studio with a plain backdrop and a textured surface suggesting a decorative carpet.

artworks.title: View across a River to a Walled City at Sunset
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape from an elevated viewpoint, featuring a river or body of water, with a medieval cityscape silhouetted against the skyline. The city spans from left to right with spires and towers. The sun is low on the right, casting dramatic rays across the sky. The style is detailed with hatching and cross-hatching for texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey and black. In the foreground, there are cottages, trees, and a wooden fence. On the water, there are sailing ships with unfurled sails, leading towards the city. The artwork combines man-made and natural elements with skillful lines depicting history and a quiet life near the urban center.
